subject: Mandatory donor-code adoption ladder: runtime candidate / experiment / process-tooling
body: External implementations must be mined for useful engineering value even when device-specific runtime behavior cannot yet be revalidated. Classify donor reuse as RUNTIME_CANDIDATE, FEATURE_FLAGGED_EXPERIMENT, or PROCESS_TOOLING_ADOPTION. Process/tooling ideas may be adopted without Fold7 field proof when they do not assert device semantics; runtime authority/power/privacy/display mechanisms still require current-source and Fold7 evidence. Preserve applicable licenses/attribution. Current donor review: joeconsorti/duo-fold-live.
